notes: Page title: 'Yummy Salads', plus 'Twisted Sw's' section (heading printed as 'Twisted Sw's' even though items are salads). Branded with 'Junktion77 - The Foodies' Crossroads' logo top-right. Dark forest-green background with gear pattern; headings in white decorative calligraphic serif; item names bold tan/gold serif; descriptions small white sans-serif; prices tan with '/-'. Green/red veg/non-veg markers on all items. Intro: 'If you fancy a salad with a twist, here it is .....'. 'Choose Your Dressing: Mayo / Yogurt / Lemon / Flavoured Mayo / Spicy Ranch Dressing' captured as a no-price section. Bottom photo: crispy fried chicken tenders over salad with shredded cheese. No tax/charges text. Fully legible.
